title: Velvet Cap Sleeve A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Make a stunning entrance in this velvet A-line dress! Featuring elegant cap sleeves and a flattering silhouette, this timeless piece is perfect for wedding guests. The luxurious velvet fabric adds a touch of sophistication, ensuring you shine at every special occasion.


Tips: Highly elastic fabric; stretches at least 2 inches.
Prioritize selecting based on bust measurement.
Choose one size smaller if you prefer a snug fit.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: Not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises velvet.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
